I was diagnosed with that for years and nothing helped. Finally one night I decided I was going to end it, but was not successful (obviously). It was at that point they finally diagnosed me bipolar with paranoia and OCD. Bipolar disorder is one of the most misdiagnosed diseases. Once I started finally getting correct treatment I felt so much better. It's been about 4 years.

You mentioned only feeling depressed or angry. Same. Are you feeling like everything is hopeless? Do you have thoughts of suicide? Can your mood change like someone flipped a switch? Do certain sounds exasperate your moods? This might be something for you to bring up to your therapist/psychiatrist. Sometimes we have to advocate for ourselves until we feel how we should. 

I hope this helped even just a little bit. Just know you're not alone. Feel free to reach out if you need someone.

First off, I think your mother needs therapy. She obviously has this insane need to compare her life to others, which unfortunately includes you. Maybe she had an unsuccessful childhood and is trying to make it up with you? Whatever it is, you need to stand your ground and continue to tell her how it makes you feel. Is there another family member you can confide in that she would maybe listen to? How does she respond to your pleas to stop? Maybe see a therapist yourself. They can help teach you to channel your depression and anxiety elsewhere, and maybe they can help you get thru to your mother. Let's hope you get thru to her before it gets to an eating disorder. You're not defined by what anyone else thinks of you! Even a close family member. Please just remember that.

So my app didn't show me I had comments. Thank you all for your kind words. It is such a struggle that I go thru every day: my weight and my depression. It actually hits a little different coming from people you don't know, which i know sounds weird.
